title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Process of Online Data Handling
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a user's personal data is collected, processed, and used when they interact with a website. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先花约2分钟分析流程图，识别主要阶段和关键步骤。写作时，用一段引言转述题目，然后用主体段落概括流程的主要特征，并进行比较（例如步骤的先后、数据流向的变化、涉及方的角色等）。注意使用恰当的连接词和被动语态。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。字数至少150词。

figure.title: The process of personal data handling on a website
steps: User visits website and provides personal data (e.g., name, email, browsing behaviour)
Data is transmitted to the website's server via a secure connection
Server stores data in a database and may share it with third-party analytics services
Analytics services process data to generate user profiles and behavioural insights
Profiles are used to personalise content, recommendations, and advertisements
User may be asked to consent to cookies and data tracking
User can access, update, or delete their data through account settings
Data may be retained for a specified period or until user requests deletion
